body: Maintainer GUI-tested this build (2026-11-19): Panel setups save, load and auto-load all behaved, no refusals and no diagnostics in the run log. The dependency change (egui_dock serde feature, serde for camcraft-ui) stays open for his label and merge decision.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 89d1f67cccee9c8d4c21586de22a9c517852cff2 -->
**Review: clean on all build checks. Verdict: needs-maintainer.** Reviewed by the SlaveSession PR-reviewer agent (built review). (A queue note before this said a review was posted at 02:30; it never reached GitHub. This is the review of record.)

**Built.** Head `89d1f67cc` merged with current `main` (trial merge, no conflicts).
- `camcraft-ui` lib: 1241 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored (six panel-setup pins + the named layout test, none lost).
- `camcraft-app` lib: green (prefs store unit tests included).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Checks.**
- View state stays view state: load rides the one-frame `apply_ask` mailbox, never the command history; the dock layout is not document data. Correct under Everything Is a Command.
- Permanence law: `setups.rs::validate` refuses a `Tab::Viewport` in a float and a rootless main area; corrupt or older files load the default layout with a diagnostic. Pinned by `a_viewport_in_a_float_is_refused` and `a_corrupt_setup_loads_the_default_layout_with_a_diagnostic`.
- Setups live in `panel-setups.json` beside the theme (application settings), never in the project file - the project format does not move.
- The file format carries the `camcraft-panel-setups/1` tag; a future shape steps it.
- The body asks for the maintainer's decision on the dependency change, so the yellow label is correct; agents cannot set it. This review does not decide it.

**What needs the maintainer's read.** `egui_dock = "=0.21.1"` gains its `serde` feature; `camcraft-ui` gains the existing workspace `serde`; `enumn` 0.1.14 (MIT/Apache-2.0) enters the graph as its derive helper. No new external crate beyond that one transitive helper. A `feat`: it merges at the cut after the decision.

Merge class: SAME. The head is `89d1f67cccee9c8d4c21586de22a9c517852cff2`, the head that the review of 05:44 UTC names. No commit came after that review. The PR merges cleanly with `main`. This merge relies on that review.

Dependency decision by the maintainer (2026-11-19, relayed by the main session): the `serde` feature of `egui_dock` is permitted. It adds `enumn` as a transitive dependency. This decision removes the `needs-maintainer` hold.

The maintainer ordered this merge.
